actions.name: 扶稳双脚提踵
actions.phase: 双脚提踵顶部：双前足接地、双脚跟抬起，轻扶稳固扶手。
actions.pose: Pose: supported bilateral standing heel raise, shown at the controlled TOP position. Woman faces right in a three-quarter side view, stands tall with spine neutral and both knees comfortably straight, two feet parallel hip-width apart on flat level floor. BOTH forefeet and toes remain on the floor while BOTH heels are lifted 4–6 cm, rising onto the balls of both feet. Heel-floor gaps must be unambiguous, both feet separately visible. Both hands lightly touch a stable waist-height simple gray fixed horizontal support rail in front, elbows relaxed; she is balancing, not pulling herself upward. No step, slope, squat, jumping or weight.

actions.name: 扶稳屈膝站姿提踵
actions.phase: 双膝保持轻屈的双脚提踵顶部，双前足接地。
actions.pose: Pose: supported standing BENT-KNEE bilateral heel raise at top. Woman faces right in a clear three-quarter side view, lightly touches fixed waist-height neutral gray support rail with both hands. Feet parallel hip-width apart, BOTH knees gently bent about 20–30 degrees and staying bent, hips centered, torso nearly upright, not a deep squat. BOTH heels lifted 3–5 cm above FLAT floor while BOTH balls of feet and toes stay grounded. Show the bent knees and two separate visible raised heels clearly. Knees must NOT be straight, this is specifically the bent-knee calf raise. Do not stand on a step or slope, no weights, no hopping.

actions.name: 扶稳单脚/负重提踵
actions.phase: 一手扶稳、另一手持轻哑铃的单脚提踵顶部，非训练脚离地。
actions.pose: Pose: supported SINGLE-LEG heel raise with one small light dumbbell, at controlled top. Woman faces right in three-quarter side view. Her left hand lightly rests on a simple waist-height fixed gray rail in front; right arm naturally down beside body holding ONE small light neutral dark-gray dumbbell securely. Body upright and level, LEFT supporting knee comfortably straight. LEFT forefoot/toes on flat floor and LEFT heel distinctly raised about 4–5 cm. RIGHT non-support leg gently bent at knee, right foot lifted just off the floor behind the supporting calf, not crossed awkwardly, both feet visible. Only ONE foot bears weight, no step, slope, jumping, deep bend or heavy load. Keep the dumbbell and support rail unobstructed.
